manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Changeling Hero must be exiled by Wormfang Drake, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Yannik until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
